name: ProdFAQ – Product FAQs for WooCommerce
author: ranapress

sections.description:
ProdFAQ is a lightweight and flexible WooCommerce extension that lets you add product-specific FAQs directly from the product edit screen.
With ProdFAQ, store owners can answer common customer questions right on the single product page—helping reduce pre-sale inquiries, improve clarity, and boost customer confidence.
The plugin is built with performance, simplicity, and WordPress coding standards in mind, making it easy to use for beginners and extensible for developers.

Short Description

Add product-specific FAQ accordion to WooCommerce single product pages.

Features

  • Add unlimited FAQs per WooCommerce product
  • Simple and intuitive admin meta box UI
  • Multiple FAQ display styles:
    -> Accordion
    -> Card style
    -> List style
  • Control FAQ position on the single product page
  • Clean and responsive frontend design
  • SEO-friendly HTML structure
  • Lightweight and fast — no external libraries
  • Fully translation-ready
  • Developer-friendly and extensible

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • WooCommerce must be installed and activated
  • PHP 7.4 or higher

Usage

After activating the plugin:

  1. Go to Products → Edit Product
  2. Scroll down to the Product FAQs meta box
  3. Click Add FAQ to add a new question and answer
  4. Save or update the product
  5. FAQs will appear on the product’s single page automatically

Privacy Policy

ProdFAQ does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the prodfaq folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Edit any WooCommerce product and find the Product FAQs meta box.
  5. Scroll down to the Product FAQs meta box, add your FAQs, and update the product.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. ProdFAQ works only with WooCommerce products.

Can I add multiple FAQs per product?

Yes, you can add unlimited FAQs per product.

Does it work with all WooCommerce themes?

ProdFAQ follows WooCommerce hooks and should work with most themes. Styling can be adjusted via CSS if needed.

Is this plugin SEO-friendly?

Yes. The FAQ content is output in clean HTML and can be extended with structured data if needed.

Is the plugin translatable?

Yes. The plugin is fully translation-ready using the prodfaq text domain.
